<subject>Re: Any Plans tonight?</subject>
<body>
Hey Shaun! Sorry I didn't get back to you on Friday. I left the office a bit early, so I must have missed your message. Did you all have a good evening on Friday? How’s everything on your end?

It’s been really busy here. I put in several late nights last week trying to clear the backlog. I might have to postpone buying that new car with Halcyon’s share price dipping recently. It did recover some ground on Friday and earlier today though. Fingers crossed it stays that way.

Have you heard from Max since his wedding? Nothing from him yet. Probably still basking in the newlywed glow.

  
	"Palmer, Shaun" <shaun.palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk>  
	22/03/2024 15:18  
		 
		To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk  
		cc:   
		Subject: Any Plans tonight?  

 Hey, what’s up? My brother-in-law and a friend are flying into Leeds tonight. We’re planning to head over to The Ledger, a spot that’s supposed to be like The Vault. We’ll probably get there around 10 pm. Planning to hang out there for a bit and then head downtown to find a bar. A couple of friends from business school will join us too. Thought you might want to come along. Are you in?

 Drop me a line or call me at home: +44 113 555 2092, or on my mobile: +44 7702 529 2161. I’m leaving work in a few minutes, so if I don’t reply to email, just ring me.

 Cheers,  
 E

  
	clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk  
	26/02/2024 13:39  
	To: Shaun Palmer  
	cc:  
	Subject: Re: Corporate Lending Meeting  

 Shaun, thanks for handling that. I’ll probably get to Bernard before you do. I’ll have my mobile on me: +44 7047 822161. If you arrive earlier, give me a call. Otherwise, just phone my room when you get to the hotel. Sounds good, we’ll travel together. I might bring along someone I’ve been seeing recently. We’ll see. The meeting starts at 7.

 Appreciate the tip about Dillard’s. I was going to ask about that.

 G

  
	                     Shaun.J.Palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk  
	                     To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk  
	                     cc:  
	                     26/02/2024 12:09  
	                     Subject: 2nd Hotel Room  

 Clifford,

 Good news — managed to get the second room at the same £99 rate. Below are two separate confirmation numbers. I don’t think it matters which one you use. When you check in, just give one of them. Both are on my card, so you can transfer the charge to your account at check-in.

 Not sure exactly what time we’ll get in, coming from Sheffield. I estimate around 5 pm (the meeting’s at 7, right?). We’ll be travelling there Friday since some of Hilary’s family from York will be attending too.

 If we don’t speak before then, let’s plan to meet at the hotel between 6 and 6:30. We can travel to the meeting together from there.

 By the way, they’re registered at Clarke & Sons — we got them a gift yesterday, still plenty left on the list.

 E
</body>
